note.simple: This double bond opens up so the molecule can join a chain.
note.deeper: A vinyl group; it polymerises by chain growth (free radical) with styrene.

note.simple: A carbon and a nitrogen joined by three bonds. Nitriles on neighbouring chains pull on each other, which makes the plastic stiffer and tougher.
note.deeper: The C-N triple bond is strongly polar; dipole attraction between nitrile groups binds SAN chains together and raises heat and chemical resistance.
